name: Tape Editing Deck

description.content: Each Survivor starts the Trial with a [VHS Tape], and their target [TV] is the one farthest from their location.
You see a Survivor's Aura for [6s] after they insert a [VHS Tape] into their target [TV].

quote: "Frolic in brine, goblins be thine." -Message hidden in Sadako's Tape
